summary: Namco's motorcycle racing games based on the Suzuka 8 Hours endurance event, using linked replica-bike cabinets in arcades and a distinct SNES endurance conversion.

entries.title: Suzuka 8 Hours
entries.definitive_edition: Arcade for main route; SNES for endurance-mode supplement

emulation.notes: Use MAME or original arcade hardware for primary; use accurate SNES emulation or original hardware for the endurance secondary.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Namco System 2 linked bike cabinets for primary; SNES endurance structure for completion

primary.why: Suzuka 8 Hours began as a Namco System 2 arcade motorcycle game with two-player replica-bike cabinets that could be linked for up to eight players. The arcade version is the highest-fidelity cabinet route; the SNES port simulates the full endurance concept as eight virtual hours over more than 90 real-time minutes, making it a secondary content route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the arcade version in MAME/original hardware with linked replica-bike cabinets where available; use the SNES version separately for its extended endurance-race structure.

secondary.exclusive_content: SNES port simulates the actual eight-hour race as eight virtual hours over more than 90 real-time minutes.
secondary.what_to_play: Play the SNES version if you want the extended endurance-race interpretation after the arcade primary.
secondary.why: Arcade is the cabinet-fidelity route; SNES has a sourced endurance structure not represented the same way in the arcade.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Namco System 2 arcade release with two-player replica-bike cabinets and up to eight-player linked support.
all_releases.reason: primary: original and highest-fidelity cabinet route.

all_releases.fidelity: Arc System Works SNES port with a long-form endurance simulation.
all_releases.reason: secondary: play for the extended eight-virtual-hour endurance structure.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Arcade has the replica-bike cabinet and linked multiplayer; SNES has a distinct long-form endurance interpretation.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced modern remaster; the SNES port is a distinct home interpretation rather than a fidelity upgrade.

entries.title: Suzuka 8 Hours 2

emulation.notes: Use arcade emulation or original hardware.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Namco System 2 arcade presentation with linked-cabinet multiplayer on original hardware

primary.why: Suzuka 8 Hours 2 is the direct arcade sequel to Suzuka 8 Hours, released a year later. Arcade is the only platform, with no home port or alternate release.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original arcade version in MAME/original hardware with linked cabinets where available.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only one sourced platform route; no secondary content route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced home port or remaster.
